title: Book Two · Chapter 177: The Ugly Dumpling
story:
Mum puts a ball of dough on the kitchen table on Saturday. Ronan looks at it, then at the bowl of filling.

“How many?” he asks.

“Enough for lunch. Fewer if you eat the filling first.”

He takes his hand away from the bowl. Dad comes in with a clean towel and asks for the easy job.

“You can close them,” Mum says.

“That sounds dangerous.”

Mum rolls a small piece of dough flat. She puts a spoonful of filling in the middle and folds it. Her fingers close the edge quickly. The dumpling sits upright on the board.

Dad tries. His dumpling falls on its side.

“It is resting,” he says.

Ronan's first one stays open at one end. He adds a small piece of dough to close it. Now it has a long nose.

Mum looks at it. “Who is that?”

“A visitor.”

“Does he want to come into the pot?”

“He is checking the entrance.”

Dad laughs. Ronan laughs too. He is a little surprised. He has felt sad for most of the week.

They work around the table. Mum makes the neat ones. Dad makes large ones. Ronan makes several ordinary ones after the visitor. Then the visitor's nose falls off.

“Now he can fit through the door,” Dad says.

Mum moves the broken piece aside. “Now he can go in the pot.”

While the water heats, she tells them about her afternoon. She needs to take a finished coat to a customer, then she will meet her friend for a walk. Dad will go back to work after lunch. He offers to carry the coat to the corner.

“I can take it,” Ronan says.

“You can carry it to the door with me,” Mum says. “After that, I am having my own walk.”

“May the visitor come?” Dad asks.

“He is lunch.”

They eat at the small table. The first dumpling breaks in Ronan's bowl. He catches the filling with his spoon and eats the empty dough after it.

“Both parts arrived,” he says.

Mum gives him another. Dad tells them about a customer. The customer had three boxes that looked the same. None had a clear label. Ronan listens and eats another dumpling.

After lunch, Ronan helps wash the dishes. Dad goes back to Mr Sun. Mum takes the coat from its cover and checks it once more.

Ronan walks to the green door with her. He carries the coat until she is ready, then hands it over. She goes down River Street in her own good shoes. He stands in the doorway and waves until she turns the corner.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

dough＝面团；filling＝馅；upright＝直立地；label＝标签。

## 理解问题

1. 一家人包食物时有哪些让Ronan真正开心的事？
2. Mum午后有哪些属于她自己的安排？

## 读句子

**Her fingers close the edge quickly.**

拆开看：Her fingers / close / the edge quickly.

她的手指／很快捏合／边缘。
